components.name: Active Tab Button
components.description: Gita's active tab item in the tab bar. Styled flat, blending with the control background.
components.html: New Tab
components.css: .ds-tab-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 4px; color: #1d1d1f; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-tab-button .ds-close-icon { width: 8px; height: 8px; color: #86868b; opacity: 0.8; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab-button:hover .ds-close-icon { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Inactive Tab Button
components.description: Gita's inactive tab item in the tab bar. Transparent at rest, highlighting subtly on hover.
components.html: DuckDuckGo
components.css: .ds-tab-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; border-radius: 4px; color: #86868b; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-tab-button .ds-close-icon { width: 8px; height: 8px; color: #86868b; opacity: 0.8; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab-button:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); color: #1d1d1f; } .ds-tab-button:hover .ds-close-icon { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Address Field
components.description: Plain-styled address input field matching macOS default text field inputs.
components.css: .ds-address-container { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; padding: 4px 8px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-radius: 6px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-address-container .ds-lock-icon { width: 12px; height: 12px; color: #86868b; } .ds-address-input { border: none; background: transparent; font-size: 13px; color: #1d1d1f; width: 100%; outline: none; padding: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Gita is designed around the concept of a "Liquid Workspace"—a browser chrome that is visually unobtrusive, highly responsive, and feels like an organic extension of macOS. Instead of imposing heavy branding borders, Gita adopts the Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) with a focus on translucent glass materials, thin structural lines, and native typography.

The interface prioritizes user content, fading the browser's own controls into the background when not active. Spacing is tight and efficient, keeping the maximum possible viewport space dedicated to web rendering.
keyCharacteristics: System-Adaptive Translucency: Uses macOS system materials to blend seamlessly with the user's workspace.
Refined and Native Density: Compact padding and small, precise tab button targets prevent chrome clutter.
Organic Micro-interactions: Smooth status indicator transitions to reflect behind-the-scenes memory optimization.

rules.name: The Adaptive Material Rule
rules.body: The UI must never define hardcoded background colors for its chrome. Always use system materials (.bar, Color(.windowBackgroundColor)) to allow the window appearance to naturally conform to the user's system dark mode, accent settings, and glass transparency preferences.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Brand accents (like warning orange) must represent less than 1% of the total UI surface area, reserved strictly for state communication (like secure/insecure status).

rules.name: The Font Unity Rule
rules.body: Never introduce custom web fonts or non-system typefaces into the browser chrome. The browser chrome must match the system fonts of the host operating system exactly.

rules.name: The Flat-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Browser chrome elements (tabs, address bar, navigation buttons) must remain flat. Elevated shadows are prohibited, as depth is achieved purely through system material contrast.

dos: Do use native SF Symbols for all browser control icons to match macOS system appearance.
Do align components precisely using Standard Apple spacer increments (4pt, 8pt, 12pt).
Do ensure all text contrast complies with macOS accessibility standards (e.g., ≥4.5:1 ratio).
Do respect the user's system-wide reduced motion settings when tab transition animations are introduced.
donts: Don't add cluttered multi-row toolbars or heavy chrome borders that distract from web content.
Don't use custom shadows or arbitrary border-left/border-right colored accent stripes.
Don't use custom web fonts for the browser chrome; stick to system-native types.
Don't hardcode light/dark backgrounds; always use adaptive SwiftUI colors and native material styles.
